versions.content: Name Mem If_ Job Result Type Kind Enumeration Range MEMIF_ JOB_ OK -- The job has been finished successfully. MEMIF_ JOB_ FAILED -- The job has not been finished successfully. MEMIF_ JOB_ PENDING -- The job has not yet been finished. MEMIF_ JOB_ CANCELED -- The job has been canceled. MEMIF_ BLOCK_ INCONSISTENT -- 1. The requested block is inconsistent, it may contain corrupted data. 2. Block is NOT found. MEMIF_ BLOCK_ INVALID -- The requested block has been marked as invalid, the requested operation can not be performed. Description Denotes the result of the last job. Available via Mem If.h
